title: Normalizing Flows are Capable World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used

translated_title: 归一化流是能力强大的世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型使智能体能够预判自身动作的后果，并利用想象中的未来场景进行决策。我们提出了归一化流世界模型（Normalizing-Flow World Model, NFWM），它将一个可逆的观测编码器与一个动作条件下的概率预测器相结合。由于编码器是可逆的，对潜在状态预测出的分布可以定义未来观测的分布。因此，最大化这些观测的精确条件似然能够联合训练表示与动力学。智能体可以在学到的潜在空间中直接进行规划，并通过解码采样出的轨迹来检视可能的未来。在Teleport环境中，这些采样能够捕捉到同一动作的两种可能结果。在Flappy Bird中，仅通过似然训练的世界模型即可支持基于奖励的规划，在全部十个评估游戏中均达到100根管道的成绩。对于目标条件控制任务，一个辅助的逆动力学目标用于塑造所使用的坐标表示（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出基于归一化流的世界模型NFWM，利用可逆编码器通过精确似然最大化联合训练表示与动力学，支持潜在空间规划、基于奖励的规划以及目标条件控制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NFWM, a world model built on normalizing flows that leverages an invertible encoder to jointly train representation and dynamics via exact likelihood maximization, enabling latent-space planning, reward-based planning, and goal-conditioned control.
